svg.title: About Kaayaeeshan
svg.desc: My main focus is artificial intelligence and machine learning. I enjoy exploring data, identifying patterns, and building models to solve practical problems. Through hands-on projects, I’m developing my skills in data preparation, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation. Alongside AI and ML, I build full-stack applications that connect models with backend services, databases, and user interfaces. I’m particularly interested in intelligent healthcare and automation. My goal is to grow as an AI/ML-focused software engineer, turning experiments into useful applications through testing, learning, and continuous improvement.
